Department of Pharmacy，Taizhou Municipal Hospital，Taizhou318000，China)［Abstract］ Objective To acknowledge the monoamine oxidase inhibitors ( MAOIs) and the interactions of MAOIs with other drugs． Methods The records related to MAOIs were summarized and concluded by investigating the drug instructions and retrieving the medical literatures in domestic and foreign database． Results There were 11 commonly used drugs belonging to MAOIs，and nearly 40 drugs had pharmacological interactions with MAOIs． Conclusion In order to reduce the adverse drug reactions，the dose of 11 drugs should be decreased when being used with MAOIs，or the combination should be avoided．
